name: Collins
source:
The Hot and Cold Lover

Inexperienced with love, he may not always know the right way to act. This younger vampire brother has a wild side and knows how to get what he wants. But the more you get to know him, the less his cool composure can hide his true longing for a loving relationship.

[From [url=https://capiora.ru/category/genius-inc/beautiful-blood-yaoi-vampire-bl]CapiOra[/url]]
